stories.title: 'The team being hunted': Why things feel -- and look -- different for the Patriots in 2026
stories.summary: After an eventful offseason with much roster turnover, New England is again focusing on identity to combat a harder schedule.

stories.title: Cunningham: WNBA needs 'bold' commissioner
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham said the WNBA needs a "bold" commissioner "who wants the best for the players and not maybe for themselves."

stories.title: Kyrgios reveals he tested positive for cocaine
stories.summary: Former Wimbledon finalist Nick Kyrgios revealed on Wednesday he tested positive for cocaine and was provisionally suspended from tennis.

stories.title: Sources: Giants trade Faalele to OL-needy Jags
stories.summary: The Giants are trading guard Daniel Faalele to the Jaguars for an undisclosed late-round 2027 draft pick, sources confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: Sparks star Ogwumike retiring at end of season
stories.summary: Los Angeles Sparks star Nneka Ogwumike, an 11-time WNBA All-Star, announced Wednesday she will retire at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
